By turning on this feature, you are enabling the automation to make configuration changes. Enabling automation may be opted out of at a later time or supplemented by existing manual tools. It is recommended to review all changes made and to review each upgrade task before proceeding to the next.
Test generator app isn't installed someone with an admin role needs to install it before you can automate tests

Enable auto-generate ATF tests to allow ServiceNow to use ATF Test Generator tool to intelligently generate regression tests for your upgrade process. You may review the start time for test generation and estimated duration before the tests are ready for use.
Note: Generated ATF tests will run automatically post-upgrade.
Upgrade store applications to latest version
Automate Upgrade store applications to latest version

Enable store application upgrade to ensure all applications are upgraded to the latest available version. If you’re not upgrading to the latest version, manually select a compatible version during the store application upgrade step.
Note: If the upgrade plan was imported, applying the latest versions to all items may override the imported configuration.

Our AI agent is designed to assist you in troubleshooting any failed tests during the upgrade process. By leveraging advanced algorithms, it can analyze the issues and provide actionable insights to resolve them efficiently.
